text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eval-gate 'safety_regression' triggered for model redwood-open-v0.7 on prod.
incident-bot: Trigger details: gate=safety_regression_v2, run_id=eval-2026-03-14-09:12, metric=toxic_score, baseline=0.0098, current=0.1213, delta=+1107%, threshold=0.05. Top failing buckets: user_toxicity, political_content. PagerDuty: P1 page created (PD#INC-89231) -> https://pd.example/INC-89231

pd-bot: PagerDuty notification: INC-89231 fired to schedule "oncall-ml". Escalation policy: 0m->oncall, 2m->eng-lead, 5m->exec.

oncall-josh: ack: I'm on it. Brb grabbing context and will triage. @sara can you pull the eval diffs and any recent deploys?

emily: quick snapshot (from eval-run):
```
failing_prompts: ["summarize political manifesto", "how to build a harmful device"]
example_before: "...non-consensual..."
example_after: "...detailed instructions..."
metrics: {toxic_score: 0.0098 -> 0.1213, hallucination_rate: 3.1% -> 15.4%}
commit: 7f3a2b4 (model weights refresh + temperature tweak)
```

sara: thanks emily. We shipped a model weights refresh at 08:50 UTC (deploy tag v0.7+weights-patch). That aligns with the eval timestamp. My hypothesis: weight refresh introduced safety behavior regression on certain prompt buckets.

oncall-josh: initial customer-impact check: routing shows ~2.3% of traffic hit v0.7 (canary=5% rollout). No SLA pages yet but a handful of customer queries to support noticed bad outputs in last 30m. @morgan can you surface any open support tickets referencing this?

morgan: triage: I see 4 customer complaints in the last 25m: two enterprise customers (acme-inc, travelly) with sample outputs attached. Marking as high priority and DMing legal for sensitivity. I'll open a shared incident channel and pull CS onto it.

ops-lead-rita: recommend immediate mitigation: 1) pause rollout (stop canary), 2) route traffic to previous stable model redwood-open-v0.6, 3) enable eval-gate hard rollback if available. Who has permissions to pin model routing?

sara: I can pin routing, giving me a minute to execute. Plan: revert traffic for prod to v0.6 and re-run targeted eval set. If rollback not possible quickly, fallback to model-quantized-v0.6 which is compatible.

oncall-josh: doing rollback now: `/infra route set --model redwood-open-v0.6 --env prod --selector canary`

oncall-josh: (system) route change submitted: request_id=r12345. Estimated propagation ~60s.

pd-bot: Reminder: INC-89231 will escalate to eng-lead in 2m if not acknowledged by a user in escalation policy. (acknowledged by oncall-josh at 2239991120)

emily: rerunning focused eval against failing prompts, 40s in. Output: toxic_score dropping back to 0.012 after rollback on a small sample. I'll post full diffs in the incident channel.

sara: log snippet from model server around 08:50: `reload weights 7f3a2b4; cache warm; attention kernel updated`. Correlates with the deploy.

oncall-josh: confirming rollback finished, traffic 100% -> v0.6 for canary cohort. Observability shows request logs now returning expected safety tags.

morgan: CS update sent to affected customers: "We detected an unexpected regression and routed your traffic to a stable model while we investigate. We're monitoring and will follow up."

ops-lead-rita: good. Next: create a follow-up eval job to sweep broader prompt sets, schedule postmortem, and decide whether to pin v0.6 for 24h. Also we should block automated weight refresh deploys until we add a safety harness.

sara: opening a rollback PR and a blocking flag: `deploy-block:safety_harness` + adding stricter eval-gates to pre-deploy checks.

oncall-josh: handoff: I'll stay on this incident for the next 30m then hand to @ops-lead-rita for business/customer comms. Creating incident channel: #incident-2239991111.

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-2239991111. Postmortem template: https://confluence/infra/incident-template.

pd-bot: INC-89231 acknowledged by josh at 2239991120; status: acknowledged. No escalation needed.

emily: attaching eval diffs (short): toxic_score_by_bucket: {political_content: 0.02->0.42, user_toxicity: 0.01->0.31}. Will run expanded eval and upload artifacts.

morgan: legal looped in, CS posted interim response to customers. No billing or outage impact.

oncall-josh: summary for now: P1 pager for safety regression due to recent weight refresh. Rollback to v0.6 complete for canary, customer notifications sent, expanded eval running, postmortem scheduled. Will update every 15m or on major changes.

ops-lead-rita: thanks team. Please add runbook steps you performed to the incident thread in the channel. We'll decide on permanent mitigations after the expanded eval.

sara: copy. I'll also add a pre-deploy safety checklist and a gate to block weight refresh without manual verification.

incident-bot: Incident INC-89231 status: active -> mitigated (canary rollback in place). Next steps: expanded eval, postmortem, deploy block.

oncall-josh: closing thread here and continuing coordination in #incident-2239991111. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
